questionText:

Dynamic Motors Ltd. operates two heavy truck assembly plants. In Plant B, the manager, Ms. Ananya, adopts a 'Democratic (Participative) Leadership Style': she regularly consults shopfloor supervisors before finalizing production targets, respects constructive feedback, and encourages collective decision-making, generating high team morale.
